name: gizza-ai/image-vignette
summary: Add a soft darkened, lightened, or colored vignette with adjustable strength around an image's edges.

tool.description: Add a soft darkened, lightened, or colored vignette around the edges of an image. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call); optional strength 0-100 (default 40), mode darken|lighten (default darken), color (name or hex, darken mode only, default black), center_x/center_y as percent of the image size (default 50/50, the middle), and format keep|png|jpg|webp (default keep).

center_x.description: Horizontal center of the vignette as a percent of the image width: 0 = left edge, 50 (default) = middle, 100 = right edge.

center_y.description: Vertical center of the vignette as a percent of the image height: 0 = top edge, 50 (default) = middle, 100 = bottom edge.

color.description: Vignette color for darken mode: a name (black, white, gray, sepia, navy, red, …) or hex like #1A2B3C / #A52. black (the default) is the classic look; try sepia for a vintage fade. Not combinable with mode=lighten.

format.description: Output format: keep (default) preserves the input format (and any animation); png, jpg or webp convert — an animated GIF keeps only its first frame when converting.

mode.description: darken (default) darkens the edges like a classic lens vignette; lighten brightens them instead for a faded, hazy border.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

strength.description: Vignette strength, 0-100. 0 leaves the image unchanged, 40 (the default) is a classic soft vignette, 100 fades the corners fully to black (or white in lighten mode). Example: 80 for a dramatic look.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
